name: nexus-arbitrage-hub
description: Unified Arbitrage Hub - Real Trading Engine

scripts.secret:all: pwsh -Command "Get-Content api_keys.txt | ForEach-Object { $line=$_.Trim(); if($line -and -not $line.StartsWith('#')) { $parts=$line -split '=',2; if($parts.Count -eq 2) { $parts[1].Trim() | npx wrangler secret put $parts[0].Trim() } } }"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run secret:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run deploy
